evidence.detail: The class extends rs/cache/b/d, labels itself 'Cache', owns cache.zip/cache_version, and displays 'Downloading main game assets..' while downloading and extracting the main asset archive.
It constructs rs/cache/b/e for cache_version and participates in the common local-vs-remote version/update decision inherited from the updater base.
Its archive cleanup/extraction logic explicitly preserves/handles cache asset directories such as configs and sprites, fixing this as the main game asset updater.
The class extends rs/cache/b/d, uses configs.zip and config_version, and displays 'Downloading game configs..' during update.
It owns an rs/cache/b/e version descriptor keyed by config_version and delegates shared archive/version behavior to the updater base.
Its surviving path constants and extraction flow target the configs asset directory.
The class extends rs/cache/b/d, labels itself 'Sprites', uses sprites.zip and sprite_version, and displays 'Downloading sprites..' during update.
It owns an rs/cache/b/e version descriptor keyed by sprite_version and uses the same shared download/extract/version workflow.
Its surviving path constants and extraction flow target the sprites asset directory.
The class owns three rs/cache/b/d updater instances—main cache, sprites, and configs—plus a List of those updaters and the live Client.
Startup displays 'Please wait, checking assets..', checks each updater, runs outdated assets, reports updater-specific errors, and emits 'Updating outdated game asset: ...' status.
Its constructor creates exactly rs/cache/b/a/a, rs/cache/b/a/d, and rs/cache/b/a/c, proving central orchestration of the three asset updater types.
The class is abstract, owns updater error messages/client/base path, exposes abstract update/version hooks, and provides shared local-vs-remote version comparison.
Shared behavior downloads URLs, creates directories, extracts ZipInputStream entries, writes files, and cleans update artifacts.
The exact concrete subclasses are the main-cache, config, and sprite updater implementations coordinated by rs/cache/b/c.
The class resolves remote versions.txt and local versions.dat paths, parses named double version entries, and can persist version entries locally.
Its public methods expose remote and local version doubles and a boolean update/version check used directly by rs/cache/b/d.
On remote-version connection failure it constructs an HTML diagnostic pane and installs the already-recovered R336 AssetVersionHyperlinkListener, directly tying this class to asset-version status.
